notes.title: Orbital Invaders galaxy update
notes.content:
It's time to defend galaxy commander!
Take your spaceship and destroy all enemies as a real Space Ranger.

[previewyoutube=4guo5PEsTIk;full][/previewyoutube]

In this update:


 - Collect gems and upgrade your weapon, bombs and get extra life.
 - Xbox and PS3 controllers are supported.
 - New atmospheric music.
 - Better performance and graphics.
